title: Settings
description: Personal preferences (this browser) and shared server settings.

personal.scopeNote: These are stored in this browser only — they don't sync across browsers or devices, and don't affect other users.

language.title: Language
language.label: UI language
language.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

theme.title: Theme
theme.label: Color theme
theme.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

server.scopeNote: These are saved on the server and shared by everyone. Changes take effect for the whole deployment.

agentPrune.title: Long-offline agent cleanup
agentPrune.description: Automatically remove agents (PCs) that stopped sending heartbeats this long ago. Offline machines that come back reappear on their next heartbeat, so only genuinely-retired ones stay gone.
agentPrune.label: Prune after no heartbeat for
agentPrune.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly). With no default, blank means cleanup is off — long-offline agents are kept forever.

collectRetention.title: Collected-bundle retention
collectRetention.description: How long collected file bundles (from `collect:` jobs, shown on the Collect page) are kept before they auto-expire. Applied to the storage bucket immediately on save — no restart needed. Total disk stays capped regardless, so older bundles are also dropped once the bucket fills.
collectRetention.label: Keep bundles for
collectRetention.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly, currently 30 days). Extending this keeps bundles longer; the bucket's size cap still bounds total disk.

objectStoreCaps.title: Object store disk caps
objectStoreCaps.description: Per-bucket disk limit (MiB) for each NATS Object Store. Once a bucket fills, the oldest objects are evicted automatically. Applied immediately on save — no restart needed. Together the buckets share the broker-wide limit (max_file_store, 50 GB by default). Warning: evicting an old agent_releases / app_packages version breaks any rollout that still references it — size these buckets for the versions your active rollouts and retention habits need.
objectStoreCaps.blankHint: Leave a field blank to use that bucket's default (shown faintly).
objectStoreCaps.overBudget: The total of {{total}} MiB exceeds the broker-wide object-store budget ({{max}} MiB). Lower one or more buckets.

sessionTtl.title: Login session lifetime
sessionTtl.description: How long a SPA / CLI login stays valid before you have to sign in again. Applies to tokens minted after the change, not already-issued sessions. Disabling an account still takes effect immediately, regardless of this window.
sessionTtl.label: Expire login after
sessionTtl.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly, currently 24 hours). Allowed range is 1–8760 hours (up to 365 days).

checkStale.title: Compliance staleness window
checkStale.description: How long a check result may go without a fresh report before the Compliance page treats it as out of scope and hides it (and drops it from the counts). A PC that stops running a check — excluded via a dynamic group, decommissioned, or its schedule removed — drops off after this window instead of showing as permanently failing. The row is never deleted; it's just hidden (revealable on the Compliance page).
checkStale.label: Hide checks with no result for
checkStale.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly, currently 30 days). Set 0 to disable (show every row). Allowed range is 0–3650 days.

controllerGroup.title: Controller group (trusted runners)
controllerGroup.description: The agent group whose members may run `tier: controller` jobs (e.g. a `feed:` job that fetches an external URL). These jobs are never dispatched to employee endpoints — only to members of this group.
controllerGroup.label: Controller group name
controllerGroup.blankHint: Leave blank and controller-tier jobs run nowhere (fail-safe) — the safe default so an external fetch never lands on an endpoint by accident.

agentInstall.title: Agent installer
agentInstall.description: Connection settings baked into the installer ZIP served on the Agent Install page — used by fresh Windows PCs on first install.
agentInstall.natsUrlPlaceholder: blank = this backend's configured NATS URL
agentInstall.natsUrlHint: Leave the URL blank and installers use the NATS URL this backend is configured with. Remote PCs need a broker address they can actually reach.
agentInstall.natsTokenPlaceholder: type a new token to replace the stored one
agentInstall.tokenNotSet: No token configured — set one only when the broker requires it.
agentInstall.tokenHint: The stored token is never displayed. Saving with the field blank keeps the current token.

mail.title: Email (SMTP) settings
mail.description: The outbound SMTP relay used for compliance-alert notifications and account setup links. Non-secret connection settings only.
mail.restartHint: Changes take effect after the backend restarts — the backend builds its mailer once at startup.
mail.usernamePlaceholder: leave blank for an unauthenticated relay
mail.passwordHint: The SMTP password is not set here — it's a server-side secret (the MailPassword registry value or the KANADE_MAIL_PASSWORD environment variable).
mail.blankHint: Fill in the host and from-address to enable email; clear them both to disable it (email becomes a no-op).
mail.invalid: Enter a host, a valid from-address (with @), and a port between 1 and 65535 — or clear the host and from-address to disable email.

supportCodes.title: Support codes (Client App unlock)
supportCodes.description: The IT desk types one of these on a user's machine to reveal jobs carrying `client.unlock` in the Client App catalog, for a limited window — a way to surface heavier actions during a support call.
supportCodes.scopeNote: This is a display gate, not an authorization boundary. It hides jobs; it does not forbid running them (SPA / CLI execution works regardless of unlock state). Approval controls for privileged work belong on the SPA execution path.
supportCodes.empty: No codes configured. Until one is, jobs carrying `client.unlock` are hidden from everyone.
supportCodes.label: Display name (optional)
supportCodes.writeOnlyHint: The code is stored hashed and can never be read back (it is never displayed and never returned by the API). To change it, enter a new one. The scope must match a job's `client.unlock` exactly.

errors.scope: Scope may only contain A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - and must not be empty.
errors.codeShort: The code must be at least 8 characters.
errors.codeWhitespace: The code must not start or end with whitespace (the Client App trims what the user types, so it could never be entered).
errors.ttl: Valid-for must be 1-480 minutes (leave blank for the 15-minute default).
errors.label: The display name must not be only whitespace. Leave it blank instead.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate this code?
rotateConfirm.description: The existing code for scope "{{scope}}" becomes unrecoverable. Anyone still carrying the old one will no longer be able to unlock.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this support code?
deleteConfirm.description: Removes the code for scope "{{scope}}". Jobs carrying that scope become hidden from everyone.

restart.title: Restart backend
restart.description: Restart the backend service to apply settings that only take effect at startup (e.g. the mail relay). The API is unavailable for a few seconds while it comes back, and this page reloads automatically.
restart.confirmDescription: The backend service will restart and the API will be unavailable for a few seconds. In-flight requests may fail. This page reloads once it's back.
restart.toast: Backend is restarting — this page will reload shortly.
